source_snapshot.test_name_items: Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware by Web when system is off
source_snapshot.procedure:
【Before Test】
    1. Check that the SUT configuration (e.g., hardware, firmware, drivers, etc.) matches the specifications/recipe definition.
    2. Clear logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.).

    【During Test】
    Upgrade / Downgrade BMC firmware through web UI.

    【After Test】
    1. Collect test results and photos, and save them to specific folders.
    2. Check if there are unexpected logs (e.g., dmesg, syslog, SEL, etc.) generate after test.
source_snapshot.criteria: Firmware should be flashed successfully after BMC reset only one time.

deepseek_columns.ai_packages_needed: browser/automation to drive the BMC web-UI flash page + BMC image (user provides)
deepseek_columns.ai_commands: DeepSeek proposes placing a user image, driving upload/start/wait controls with the host off, and checking BMC version afterward.
deepseek_columns.ai_logs_output: Screenshots, flash-completion status and pre/post BMC version.
deepseek_columns.risk: DeepSeek correctly identifies an interruptible BMC firmware write.

historical_reviews.deepseek: PARTIAL; keeps the WebUI/off-state lifecycle but assumes browser automation can own the same UI operation and observation that the Master row tests.
historical_reviews.gpt_v2: BLOCKED / CHANGED; adds sound firmware gates but elevates missing versions, reset detail and recovery inputs into a permanent block.
historical_reviews.round_02: Entry 724/2291 retains the attended BMC WebUI method and one-reset criterion.
historical_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: The archived draft classified this variant MANUAL ONLY but is not reused as proof because the checkpoint was non-atomic.
historical_reviews.v3_1: ED-25/ED-31 keep unqualified WebUI operation and visible state engineer-owned; ED-33 through ED-38 keep project bindings separate from capability.

original_test_intent: Have an engineer upgrade and downgrade BMC firmware through the BMC WebUI while the host is off but management standby remains available, and demonstrate a successful version transition with exactly the project-defined single BMC reset for each selected direction.
original_method: The Master row requires the BMC WebUI rather than a Redfish or CLI substitution; its linked script is a post-update raw-IPMI version check, not the firmware-write mechanism.
manual_activity: A qualified engineer establishes host-off with BMC standby retained, selects the signed image in WebUI, confirms the destructive action, observes progress/error states and the reset, and records the visible terminal result. No qualified UI automation contract is approved for this Master method.
required_inputs: signed image files with hashes and compatibility approval
vendor WebUI procedure and browser/session requirements
configuration-preservation and one-reset policy per transition
stable standby power, maintenance window and alternate recovery path
safety_requirements: Host off must not be interpreted as AC removed or BMC unpowered; verify standby management reachability before upload.
Do not select or upload an image until model/version compatibility, transition direction and recovery are approved.
A browser disconnect during the expected BMC reset is not permission to resubmit, refresh into another action or add a reset.
Preserve the first failure, reset timeline, BMC configuration and SEL evidence; do not automatically retry either direction.
agent_execution_scope: Before the manual core, organize image hashes, capture read-only BMC version/health/configuration and verify host-off plus BMC reachability.
After the engineer completes the WebUI action, collect independent active-version, management-network, configuration, SEL and later host-boot evidence.
Do not click the WebUI flash controls, claim visible completion or issue the final PASS/FAIL/BLOCKED verdict.
engineer_actions: Approve and perform the WebUI upgrade and downgrade sequence under the defined host-off/standby condition.
Identify whether the one-reset rule applies separately to each transition and judge the visible update and post-reset evidence.

command_applicability.original_deepseek_command_fit: Its description follows the high-level lifecycle but changes engineer-operated WebUI coverage into unspecified browser automation and assumes that a version read plus clean reset is the whole acceptance.
command_applicability.command_recommendation: Retain the vendor BMC WebUI as the manual test method. The linked raw-IPMI version script may provide independent post-reset evidence only after its platform-specific command and field mapping are verified.
command_applicability.original_parameters_and_time_preserved: The WebUI method, system-off condition, upgrade/downgrade scope, one BMC reset, linked script and 5/15-minute planning values are preserved.

modernized_recommendation.recommended_method: Use the vendor-approved WebUI manually and pair its visible transaction record with independent read-only inventory and recovery evidence.
modernized_recommendation.applicable_platform: The exact BMC platform whose release procedure supports WebUI update while the host is off and BMC standby is powered.
modernized_recommendation.supported_version: Record BMC hardware/firmware, WebUI build, browser and raw-IPMI script revision.
modernized_recommendation.official_reference: Project-approved BMC WebUI update, reset, configuration-preservation and recovery procedure.
modernized_recommendation.difference_from_original_method: No replacement; adds explicit host-power semantics, reset accounting and independent post-reset checks.
modernized_recommendation.coverage_difference: Redfish or vendor-CLI execution could satisfy a project-approved BMC update objective but would not prove this Master WebUI path unless its coverage difference is recorded.
modernized_recommendation.required_inputs: Version matrix, reset policy, standby-power evidence and recovery.
modernized_recommendation.risks_limitations: The Web session can disappear during BMC reset, so visible loss of connection is not itself success or failure.

project_override_considerations: A project may approve another update tool, but must record original WebUI versus actual method, approval, reason, equivalence and the unverified WebUI coverage. It may not claim the Master WebUI method passed from API-only evidence.
expected_evidence: Approved BMC/image/version matrix with signatures and hashes
host-off state with retained BMC standby/network baseline
engineer-owned WebUI screenshots for selected image, confirmation, progress, terminal status and error-free completion
timestamped single-reset sequence for each executed direction
independent active-version, configuration, health, SEL and management-reachability evidence
subsequent host power-on/POST/OS health and engineer verdict

source_conflict_analysis.analysis: Items, Procedure and Criteria consistently describe BMC WebUI upgrade/downgrade with the system off and one BMC reset. Exact images, reset initiator/timing and off-state electrical definition are project bindings rather than contradictory Master intents.

blocked_analysis.analysis: The target, operation, required WebUI path, host condition and reset-count objective are understandable. Missing images, version order, detailed reset timing and recovery are execution-readiness inputs under ED-36, so the review is not permanently blocked.

comparison_to_prior_reviews.deepseek: Changes its PARTIAL capability to MANUAL ONLY because this row's function under test includes engineer-operated WebUI image selection, confirmation and visible progress; keeps its image and interruption warnings.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.gpt_v2: Retains the critical safety and recovery gates but removes permanent BLOCKED because Project SPEC can bind the missing versions and reset plan without changing the test purpose.
comparison_to_prior_reviews.invalid_checkpoint_1000: Independently confirms manual WebUI ownership while restating the source-specific role of the raw-IPMI script and browser-reset loss.

review_improvement: Makes the WebUI transaction—not merely a BMC version change—the covered interface, defines host-off as distinct from loss of standby power, and makes the single reset auditable per approved transition.
independent_technical_reasoning: BMC standby power and network normally remain available while the host is in an off state, so the attended WebUI lifecycle is technically coherent. The firmware images and reset semantics must be supplied before execution, but they do not obscure what is being tested. Because UI operation and observation are the Master path and no qualified UI automation is approved, the complete capability is MANUAL ONLY.
